baseline_models.focus_anchor: The imperative at word 1, its coordinated objects at words 2-4, the descent at word 6, and the work/خبير closure at words 9-10.
baseline_models.mechanism: Heart-settling trust and assenting reception join the divine source, carried message, and illuminating disclosure; received light then becomes intentional action whose interior is known, so the closure tests whether illumination has become practice.

activation_trace.role: Heart-settling security gives the imperative an entrusted rather than merely propositional posture.
Assent that calms the heart supplies the receptive act by which the disclosure is credited.
The carried saying binds the messenger to transmissible content in the reception chain.
Illumination supplies disclosure and makes a practical field visible.
Conveyance and delivery make the light an arrival rather than a self-generated insight.
Purposive action is the behavioral issue of receiving the light.
Knowledge of an affair's interior closes the mechanism by reaching beneath visible performance.

changed_reading.before: Believe in God, the messenger, and the revealed light because God knows deeds.
changed_reading.after: Entrust the heart to the source and carried disclosure until illumination becomes purposive conduct, whose inner reality as well as surface is already known.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The messenger, light, descent, and work sequence at words 3, 4, 6, and 9.
baseline_models.mechanism: A dispatch brings a visible route-marker and places it in its fitting station; belief is therefore taking bearings, while work is activating the marker in movement rather than admiring a luminous object.

activation_trace.role: Dispatch and release put an authorized bearer into motion toward recipients.
A conspicuous waymark gives the light a navigational function.
Putting something in its proper station makes the waymark deliberately situated.
Putting a thing to work converts orientation into operative use.
Interior expertise evaluates how the placed guidance is actually used.

changed_reading.before: The light is a luminous object sent from above.
changed_reading.after: The messenger delivers a waymark deliberately installed in the human field; faith takes its bearings and action travels by it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier sight and hidden/public sequence reads the focus closure backward from deed to source: action is visible output, but خبیر reaches the concealed interior and the breast from which action issues.

activation_trace.role: Purposive doing is the output whose depth is being tested.
Knowledge of inner affairs supplies penetration beneath the deed.
Heart-insight adds inward sight to the repeated work formula.
Concealment in the interior supplies the hidden pole of action.
Manifest appearance supplies the public pole against which interior knowledge is measured.
The origin from which acts issue makes the breast a generative source rather than only a container.

structural_cues: 64:2 repeats the focus work-clause with sight, and 64:4 then orders concealed, declared, and breasts before 64:8 returns to work/خبير.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies inward sight, concealment, manifestation, and an action-source; I infer the arrow from inner orientation to outward deed, while a live alternative is a non-causal list of divine knowledge domains.

changed_reading.before: God observes whatever actions people perform.
changed_reading.after: God reads an action through its public surface back into the concealed orientation from which it was produced.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context assigns roles to the focus triad: the messenger carries, clear signs disclose, conveyance reaches its endpoint, and the recipient answers with willing compliance and reliance. Belief in messenger and light is a transmission-and-response architecture, not three unrelated assents.

activation_trace.role: A bearer and carried saying supply the human transmission link.
The visible marker is the message's orienting content at the receiving end.
Delivery connects source, bearer, and received disclosure.
The contextual messengers repeat the bearer-and-message role that opponents reject.
Meaning disclosed by speech or sign makes the transmitted material evidentiary.
Willing compliance supplies the recipient-side response to delivery.
Causing the message to arrive defines the messenger's bounded function.
Explicit disclosure qualifies that conveyance as clarifying rather than coercive.
Reliant entrustment extends assent into dependence on the source after the message arrives.

structural_cues: 64:6 records rejection of human messengers with clear proofs; 64:8 commands reception; 64:12 limits the messenger to clear conveyance; 64:13 names reliance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies bearer, disclosure, arrival, compliance, and reliance; I arrange them as one communication circuit, while they could remain separate exhortations without a single causal chain.

changed_reading.before: Believe separately in God, His messenger, and the light.
changed_reading.after: Receive a circuit in which God sources, the messenger delivers, light makes the path legible, and belief answers through compliant reliance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The packet resolves the focus light and the later fire through the same root inventory. Around denial of signs, one revelatory energy can therefore be carried in two experienced registers: orienting illumination when received and exposing or consuming fire when repudiated.

activation_trace.role: Illumination supplies the receptive register in which disclosure clarifies.
The route-marker makes constructive orientation the light's practical effect.
Kindled fire supplies the same resolved root's destructive or exposing register.
Attributing falsity supplies the resistant act placed between light and fire.
A manifest sign identifies what denial refuses to read as guidance.

structural_cues: 64:10 follows the focus command closely and places denial of signs immediately before the fire outcome.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a shared resolved root, its illumination/fire branches, and the denial sequence; I supply the arrow that response changes the disclosure's experienced register, while simple contrast between unrelated light and fire remains fully live.

changed_reading.before: The commanded light and the later fire are unrelated positive and negative images.
changed_reading.after: The sent disclosure may be encountered as a waymark when trusted yet as firelike exposure when its signs are denied.

context_deltas.mechanism: The calamity sequence prevents light from meaning immunity from impact: an event strikes, trusting security holds, gentle direction reaches the heart, and the heart can turn rather than remain fixed by the blow.

activation_trace.role: Inner security anchors belief as steadiness under threat.
A descending adversity keeps revelation's descent from being read as comfort-only arrival.
A misfortune that hits supplies the disruptive event to which faith responds.
The repeated heart-security branch supplies continuity between the focus command and the struck situation.
Gentle indication toward a path supplies post-impact orientation.
The heart is the explicit site where trusted guidance is received.
Turning a thing from its face gives heart-guidance a reorienting rather than merely soothing function.

structural_cues: 64:11 orders impact, permission, belief, then heart-guidance, making the response occur inside rather than before the event.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies strike, trust, direction, heart, and turning; I infer that trusted light enables reorientation through impact, while guidance could instead mean consolation or understanding without a directional turn.

changed_reading.before: Faith in sent light should keep the believer outside darkness or harm.
changed_reading.after: Faith receives light as an inner capacity to be redirected when an unavoidable blow has already landed.

context_deltas.mechanism: Non-illumination branches of light make visible a risk inside disclosure itself: exposure can provoke aversion or social flare-up. The household sequence disciplines that energy into alertness without retaliation, erasure of the offense's trace, graceful turning, protective covering, and preservation of kinship under assay.

activation_trace.role: Aversion from ugliness gives light a discerning recoil rather than bland brightness.
A flare of enmity among people marks the relational danger that disclosure can expose or intensify.
Interpersonal dealing anchors the changed reading in the focus demand for enacted conduct.
Explicit hostility locates the social flare-up inside close relationships.
Wakeful precaution preserves discernment instead of confusing forgiveness with naivety.
Erasure of a trace supplies the first de-escalating operation on injury.
Graceful turning from an offense redirects exposure away from retaliation.
Protective covering of fault prevents its effects from governing the relationship.
Kinship supplies the close social body that the de-escalating sequence preserves.
Assaying a person like material frames family pressure as a test of what the received light produces.

structural_cues: 64:14 commands caution and then three non-retaliatory acts in one household setting; 64:15 immediately names family and wealth as assay.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies light's aversion/enmity branches and the caution-to-forgiveness sequence; I infer that revelation must govern the heat produced by exposure, while the ethical commands may simply follow belief without revising the image of light.

changed_reading.before: Light only exposes error so that the believer can reject it.
changed_reading.after: Received light also governs the relational heat of exposure: remain alert, but convert disclosed hostility into restrained, reparative action.

context_deltas.mechanism: A material model links descent, wet receptive land, blossom, expenditure, flood-retaining soil, cutting a returnable channel, doubling, and fresh growth. Revelation is provision whose sign of reception is circulation through action; hoarding blocks its flow, while release returns as multiplied yield.

activation_trace.role: Downward arrival, including rain-like descent, supplies the incoming flow.
Tree blossom supplies the visible growth by which received provision appears.
Dealings between people make circulation an enacted social use of light.
Soft low ground where water gathers supplies the receptive terrain of the analogy.
Cultivating and repairing land supplies knowledgeable tending rather than passive possession.
Money going out supplies the required release into circulation.
Earth that holds back its flood materializes the self's obstructive retention.
The cultivator who splits soil turns successful release into a productive channel.
Cutting off wealth or work for recompense supplies a channel deliberately opened toward return.
Increase by another like amount supplies multiplied yield from what was released.
Fresh plant growth makes gratitude's effect emerge materially from the circulation.

structural_cues: 64:16 orders hearing, obedience, and spending before protection from self-retention; 64:17 follows with a good loan, multiplication, and gratitude.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies descent/rain, wet land, blossom, spending, flood retention, cut capital, increase, and fresh growth; I compose the hydrological-agricultural arrow, while a purely legal-economic sequence remains the nearer alternative.

changed_reading.before: The sent light is information to possess, and later spending is a separate duty.
changed_reading.after: The light is received provision whose truth appears when it is put into circulation; retention dams it, while enacted release produces multiplied growth.

context_deltas.mechanism: The final unseen/witnessed pairing limits a simplistic account of light as total transparency. Humanly sent light moves enough of the hidden into witnessed presence to guide action, while divine inward knowledge already spans what remains hidden and what appears.

activation_trace.role: Illumination supplies partial disclosure into the human field.
Knowledge of inner affairs exceeds what illumination makes externally visible.
Uncovering a thing to the knower frames comprehensive divine knowing.
What is screened from eyes supplies the domain that remains beyond ordinary visibility.
Presence with observation supplies the disclosed domain in which action can bear witness.
A witnessing mark makes light sufficient as a sign without making it exhaustive explanation.
Accurate wisdom makes the boundary between disclosed and undisclosed purposeful rather than deficient.

structural_cues: 64:18 closes the entire sequence by coordinating the unseen and the witnessed after 64:8 coordinates light and all work.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hidden, witnessed, sign, inward expertise, and wise knowledge; I infer a measured transition rather than total unveiling, while the closing titles may describe only God and place no limit on the light image.

changed_reading.before: Light means that all relevant reality becomes transparent to the believer.
changed_reading.after: Sent light gives enough witnessed sign for responsible action while divine expertise alone comprehends both the disclosed surface and the remaining unseen.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the distant division-of-shared-meat branch of خبیر and turns knowledge into an apportionment image. It remains anchored in the focus work/خبیر closure and is activated by the next verse's gathering and transactional shortfall; downstream prose should present it as an accounting analogy, not as a lexical translation of خبیر.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The work and خبیر pair at focus words 9-10.

activation_trace.role: Human dealing supplies the transactional domain in which deeds can produce unequal shares.
Division of a jointly held animal into portions supplies the odd but concrete apportionment image.
Gathering dispersed material supplies the collection of actions before allocation.
Shortfall suffered in a dealing supplies the unequal account that gathering exposes.

changed_reading.before: God's expertise means that no deed escapes observation.
changed_reading.after: God's expertise may also be imaged as gathering dealings and exposing or apportioning the shares in which concealed shortfall becomes manifest.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the non-dominant ه د ي to ه د د mapped target and its severe-breaking branch. It remains anchored by the focus's adversity-capable descent and trusting imperative, with 64:11 joining calamity, guidance, and heart-turning; downstream prose should label breakage as a split-root activation, not claim that guidance literally means demolition.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The trusting imperative and descent at focus words 1 and 6, carried into the heart-guidance sequence.

activation_trace.role: Heart-security gives the rupture model a stable focus anchor rather than celebrating damage itself.
A descending adversity permits the sent-down construction to carry disruptive pressure.
The calamity that strikes supplies the actual impact around which the outlier activates.
The split mapped image of severe breaking supplies rupture as an exploratory mode of guidance.
Turning something from its face gives the struck heart a changed orientation after rupture.

changed_reading.before: Guidance gently shows an intact heart which route to take.
changed_reading.after: At the exploratory split-root edge, guidance may work through a blow that breaks a fixed orientation so the trusting heart can be turned.

strongest_changes: The work/خبیر closure changed from external surveillance into knowledge of the concealed source that generates public action.
Messenger and light became a source-bearer-disclosure circuit answered by compliance and reliance.
The same resolved ن و ر inventory allowed received light and denied fire to coexist as response-dependent registers.
Later spending language activated an exploratory flow model in which revelation must circulate rather than be retained.
summary.what_was_special: The packet kept materially different readings alive: inward audit, navigational placement, communication, post-impact heart reorientation, domestic de-escalation, and economic/ecological circulation. Its strongest surprises were the light/fire root reversal, the retained-earth image for stinginess, and the non-dominant guidance/breakage mapping.
remaining_uncertainties: The light-to-fire reversal may be only juxtaposition rather than a response-caused transformation.
The hydrological and apportionment models depend on distant material branches and should remain analogical.
The final unseen/witnessed titles may qualify divine knowledge without limiting what the sent light discloses.
